name: Indigotine
aliases: E132, INS 132, indigotine, indigo carmine, FD&C Blue No. 2, FD&C Blue 2, Blue 2
what_is: A synthetic certified food colour known as Indigotine and declared under different names or numbering systems depending on the market.
why_botia: BOTIA flags Indigotine because it is poorly absorbed from the intestine and can be partly metabolized by intestinal bacteria. It is authorised in both the European Union, as E132, and the United States, as FD&C Blue No. 2. JECFA established an acceptable daily intake and concluded that estimated dietary exposure does not present a health concern. In the United States, many food companies and industry groups have committed to removing petroleum-based synthetic food dyes. This is a voluntary industry transition, not a ban.
